LanguageData.SNE_SearchRadiusDesc: Maximum casualty search radius. While panic-fleeing, the effective radius can be reduced by the rescuer's health.
LanguageData.SNE_RescueOnDepartureDesc: Friendly/neutral NPCs already leaving the map may pick up a nearby downed member of their own group.
LanguageData.SNE_RescueWhileFleeingDesc: When friendly/neutral NPCs panic-flee, they may attempt to take a nearby downed comrade with them.
LanguageData.SNE_MinFleeHealthDesc: Below this health percentage, a fleeing pawn prioritizes its own survival and will not attempt a rescue.
LanguageData.SNE_ScaleFleeRadius: Reduce flee rescue radius by rescuer health
LanguageData.SNE_ScaleFleeRadiusDesc: Wounded rescuers become less willing to detour. Effective flee radius = configured radius × rescuer health.
LanguageData.SNE_RescueAnimalsDesc: Humanlike casualties are always prioritized first. Animals are only considered if no valid humanlike casualty is found.
LanguageData.SNE_DebugLoggingDesc: Writes rescue decisions to the log. Normally keep this disabled.
